clue.text: Importance of mount holding sign

indicators.note: the abbreviation for mount keeps the sign gripped between its two letters

parts.note: MT is the usual abbreviation for mount, as on maps
an omen is a sign of things to come

explanation.surface: A question of how much a mountain bearing a sign matters.
explanation.definitionFit: Something of great moment is of great importance; the noun means significance or weight.

clue.text: Measurement no longer used in competitive division

definitions.meaning: an old unit of distance, roughly three miles, now obsolete
a grouping of teams or clubs that play each other, as in football

explanation.surface: An obsolete unit of measure turns up in a sports division.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard: an archaic distance unit of about three miles, and a sporting competition grouping.

clue.text: Volunteers summed up with word of thanks

definitions.text: Volunteers summed up with word of thanks

parts.words: Volunteers summed up with word of thanks
parts.note: the volunteer reserve force is abbreviated to two letters, and those two letters also spell the informal British thank-you, ta

explanation.surface: Helpers are tallied and then thanked.
explanation.walkthrough: The Territorial Army was Britain's part-time volunteer reserve, always shortened to TA, and 'ta' is everyday British slang for thank you.
explanation.definitionFit: The British army's volunteer reserve force went by this name until 2014, so it is literally a body of volunteers.

clue.text: Joyous sensation arising in much of bay

indicators.note: the turned sensation sits inside the shortened bay
most of the word for a large bay is used, with its last letter dropped

parts.note: a gulf is a large bay

indicators.note: in a down clue, arising means the word is read from the bottom up

parts.note: a feel is a sensation

explanation.surface: Delight wells up across most of a stretch of coastline.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down answer 'arising' reads upwards; 'much of' trims only the final letter of the bay word.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words are adjectives for being full of delight; a synonym pairing.

clue.text: Assemble round unusually nice chef's business for ready-made grub

indicators.note: the word for assemble goes around the rearranged letters

parts.note: to convene is to assemble or gather

indicators.note: unusually signals the letters of nice are set out in a different order

parts.note: food is what a chef deals in

explanation.surface: Gathering around an unusually pleasant chef's firm that sells instant meals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Assemble' looks like an instruction, but it is a synonym; 'unusually' scrambles only nice, and 'round' wraps the assembly word about it.
explanation.definitionFit: Pre-prepared meals bought ready to heat are the very type of quick, ready-made grub.

clue.text: Wedding vow delayed for one besotted?

parts.note: the two words spoken at a wedding are 'I do'
later means put off or delayed

explanation.surface: A lover postpones saying the marriage vow.
explanation.definitionFit: A worshipper of idols, and by extension someone infatuated, is besotted; the question mark flags the loose sense.

clue.text: Private try-out on a regular basis? Nonsense

parts.note: a Tommy is a British private soldier

indicators.note: taking every other letter of try-out at regular intervals

explanation.surface: A soldier regularly has a trial run, which is nonsense.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on a regular basis' takes the 2nd, 4th and 6th letters of try-out: R, O, T. Tommy (Tommy Atkins) is the traditional nickname for a British soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: This is an old-fashioned British word for rubbish or foolish talk, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Predict role left for recasting

indicators.note: recasting the letters of the two words shapes them into a new form

explanation.surface: An actor's part is forecast to be handed to someone else.
explanation.definitionFit: To foretell is to tell of something before it happens; a straight synonym.

clue.text: Old fellow arresting detective? Very likely!

indicators.note: the fellow catches the detective inside himself

parts.note: a don is a university fellow
DS is a detective sergeant

explanation.surface: An old don nabbing a detective — quite probable!
explanation.definitionFit: A betting phrase for a favourite whose price is shorter than evens, hence almost certain.

clue.text: School missing first of teachers for long time

indicators.note: the school name goes without the letter named next

parts.note: Eton is the famous English public school

indicators.note: the opening letter of teachers

explanation.surface: A school lacking its leading teacher for ages.
explanation.walkthrough: Eton is a famous English private school; take away T to leave EON.
explanation.definitionFit: An aeon or eon is an immeasurably long period, an age.

clue.text: Cook's ultimate advantage concerning English rice dish

indicators.note: ultimate picks the final letter of the word Cook

parts.note: an edge is an advantage
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A cook's final edge with an English rice dish.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's reads as 'is': Cook is ultimate, so the last letter of Cook, K, comes first.
explanation.definitionFit: This Anglo-Indian breakfast dish of flaked fish, rice and eggs is a classic rice dish.

clue.text: Book that can be adjusted on radio?

definitions.meaning: a bound book, especially one of a set

definitions.text: that can be adjusted on radio?
definitions.meaning: the loudness control on a radio set

explanation.surface: An audiobook whose sound is turned up or down on the wireless.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is a single book of a series; the other is sound level, which a radio dial adjusts.

clue.text: Bins, bollards and benches for urban loungers?

definitions.text: Bins, bollards and benches for urban loungers?

parts.words: Bins, bollards and benches for urban loungers?
parts.note: the public fixtures of a town pavement, jokingly seen as chairs and tables for people idling in the city

explanation.surface: A list of public fixtures offered as seats for idlers in town.
explanation.definitionFit: Planning jargon for the fixed public objects on pavements; loungers suggests furniture in a living room.

clue.text: Strike sheep

explanation.surface: Hit a sheep.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is to ram into something; the other is the uncastrated male of the sheep.

clue.text: Host politician close to office in centre

indicators.note: the politician and final letter go inside the centre

parts.note: the core is the centre
MP is a Member of Parliament

indicators.note: the closing letter of office

explanation.surface: A host MP at the heart of the office.
explanation.definitionFit: A compère presents or hosts a variety show or broadcast; a synonym.

clue.text: Loves hosting in the flesh with the Italian part of Mediterranean diet

indicators.note: the two zeros take the phrase meaning in person as their guest

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, written O, so two loves give two Os
live means in person, in the flesh
il is the Italian for the

explanation.surface: Affection, in person, alongside an Italian staple of southern European eating.
explanation.definitionFit: Pressed from olives, this oil is a central ingredient of the healthy Mediterranean way of eating.

clue.text: Most dear minister touring centre of Nice

indicators.note: the minister goes around the picked letters as if on a tour

parts.note: a priest is a minister of religion

indicators.note: the middle two letters of Nice

explanation.surface: A beloved clergyman travelling through the heart of Nice.
explanation.definitionFit: Dear here means expensive, so most dear is most costly.

clue.text: Writer with sex appeal in confines of rich Cumbrian town

parts.note: a pen is a writing instrument

indicators.note: the sex appeal goes inside the edges of rich
the boundaries of rich, its first and last letters

parts.note: IT is old slang for sex appeal

explanation.surface: An alluring writer within reach of wealth in Cumbria.
explanation.walkthrough: Cumbria is a county in north-west England, home to the Lake District.
explanation.definitionFit: This market town in the north-west of England lies in Cumbria.

clue.text: Something to put in drink or decorate a cake?

definitions.meaning: cubes of frozen water added to cool a drink
to cover a cake with sugary frosting

explanation.surface: A party question: chill the drinks or finish the cake?
explanation.definitionFit: Frozen water goes in a cold drink; as a verb it means coating a cake in sugar frosting.

clue.text: Medical accessory in grey's redesigned

indicators.note: the letters of the words are designed afresh into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A hospital item restyled in grey.
explanation.definitionFit: A needle-and-plunger instrument for injecting fluids is a familiar piece of medical equipment.

clue.text: Mid-year calamity disrupted Sandhurst, say

indicators.note: disrupted means the letters are thrown into disorder and rearranged

explanation.surface: A disaster in the middle of the year threw an officer school into turmoil.
explanation.walkthrough: Sandhurst is Britain's officer training college for the army.
explanation.definitionFit: Sandhurst is an example of a college training officers for the army, hence 'say'.

clue.text: Require partner for supply?

definitions.meaning: economics pairs supply with its counterpart, the desire of buyers

explanation.surface: A firm needs someone to share the supply side.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means require; as a noun it is the other half of the phrase supply and ___.

clue.text: Uses bananas with instant dessert

parts.note: mo is short for moment, an instant

indicators.note: bananas is slang for crazy, so the letters go wild into a new order

explanation.surface: Use bananas with a quick pudding.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bananas' looks like fruit for the dessert but is slang for crazy, the anagram signal; mo (as in 'half a mo') is British slang for a moment.
explanation.definitionFit: A light, airy whipped pudding is a classic dessert.

clue.text: Some secret inadequacy found in sensitive element in a viewer

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A hidden shortcoming is discovered in the delicate part of a camera.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft's definition included 'found in', but those are link words joining wordplay to definition; the definition is just 'sensitive element in a viewer'.
explanation.definitionFit: The light-sensitive layer at the back of the eye; a viewer here is an eye, cryptically.

clue.text: I moan terribly about female American of bad repute

indicators.note: the rearranged letters go about the letter for female
terribly signals the letters of I moan are badly jumbled

explanation.surface: I complain dreadfully about a notorious American woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'terribly' turns I MOAN into INAMO, split around F.
explanation.definitionFit: Notorious and known for wrongdoing; the phrase is a direct synonym.

clue.text: Manage function

definitions.meaning: to be in charge of, to operate
to work or operate, as a machine does

explanation.surface: Handle the job.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is to direct a business; the other is to operate, as an engine does.

clue.text: Hazy, a bit, in pronouncing Chinese cuisine

indicators.note: the words are spoken out, and their sound gives the dish

parts.note: dim means hazy and some means a bit; together they sound like the dish

explanation.surface: A slightly vague attempt to say the name of a Chinese food.
explanation.definitionFit: Small steamed or fried dumplings and snacks, a staple of Cantonese cooking.

clue.text: My saintly character?

definitions.meaning: an exclamation of surprise, as in 'My!'
the virtue of a saint, moral excellence

explanation.surface: A boast about one's own holy nature.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are an exclamation of surprise and the quality of being virtuous.
